source_refs.note: Floatation: a main subheading of 5.7 Archimedes' principle and floatation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 101-101.

blocks.text: Agar cheez ka weight us par lagne wale upthrust se zyada ho to cheez doob jati hai. Agar weight upthrust ke barabar ya kam ho to cheez tairti hai. Jab cheez fluid mein tair rahi ho to us par upthrust us ke weight ke barabar hota hai. Tairti cheez kuch hissa hi doobi ho sakti hai. Upthrust hamesha cheez ke hataye hue fluid ke weight ke barabar hota hai. Yahi principle of floatation (tairne ka principle) hai:

blocks.title: Principle of floatation
blocks.text: Tairti hui cheez utna fluid hatati hai jis ka weight cheez ke apne weight ke barabar ho.
Archimedes' principle liquids aur gases dono par lagu hota hai. Rozana ki zindagi mein is ke bohat se istemal hain.
